name: OWLViz
description: We present a challenging benchmark for the Open WorLd VISual question answering (OWLViz) task. OWLViz presents concise, unambiguous queries that require integrating multiple capabilities, including visual understanding, web exploration, and specialized tool usage. While humans achieve 69.2% accuracy on these intuitive tasks, even state-of-the-art VLMs struggle, with the best model, Gemini 2.0, achieving only 26.6% accuracy. Current agentic VLMs, which rely on limited vision and vision-language models as tools, perform even worse. This performance gap reveals significant limitations in multimodal systems' ability to select appropriate tools and execute complex reasoning sequences, establishing new directions for advancing practical AI research.
evaluation_method: accuracy (correct answer rate for VQA-style queries requiring web/tool use)
reputation: A recent, challenging benchmark highlighting limitations of agentic multimodal systems; gaining attention for driving research on tool use and web-grounded visual reasoning.
notes: Requires external web exploration and tool integration, which complicates reproducibility and introduces nondeterminism; evaluations depend on agent/tool setup and access to up-to-date web content.
